name: Custom fields demo
description: Registers one custom field of each v1 type (string, number, boolean, enum, url, user, date, markdown) so you can try sidebar inputs and list/kanban badges without writing UI.
author: SentientTD Studios

fields.label: Ticket
fields.description: External ticket id, shown on list rows.

fields.label: Score
fields.description: Numeric score shown on the board.

fields.label: Blocked
fields.description: When on, a Blocked badge appears on the board.

fields.label: Size
fields.description: Relative effort. Distinct from the Severity extension.

fields.label: Spec
fields.description: Link to a spec or design doc. Sidebar only.

fields.label: Owner
fields.description: A project member responsible for this task.

fields.label: Review on
fields.description: Calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD). Shown in the sidebar and on list rows.

fields.label: Field notes
fields.description: Markdown notes stored on the task. Sidebar only.
